limitations: The admission, readiness and lifecycle matrices use deterministic fixtures to validate production APIs; they do not claim a completed live Papilio demoleus run.
The performance baseline was measured on Linux x86_64 under WSL2 with Python 3.14.5 and Polars 1.41.2; elapsed time and traced-memory ceilings include explicit host-variance allowances.
Reference-review count, embedding reuse and selective-rerun ratios are semantic invariants in the performance fixture, not estimates of a live corpus.
Provisional scoring remains non-probabilistic and cannot authorize scientific release.
Flickr candidates remain excluded from final output until source-bound human review and all release gates pass.

The first full regression exposed a scheduling-dependent missing failure audit; commit 3962db9 moved the existing-destination check into the audited publication transaction and the final full regression passed.
No live runtime improvement, memory saving, human-review saving or model-quality improvement is claimed.

repair.outcome: Every losing create-only readiness publisher now records a not-committed failure audit, including a writer that observes an already-published destination before staging.

tasks.outcome: Exercises thirteen explicit automated admission outcomes and human override paths through public APIs.
Covers ten strict, provisional, blocked, stale-policy, mode-change, audit, route and rejection readiness states.
Composes production APIs into ten end-to-end guarantees from provider admission through targeted remediation, selective reuse and fail-closed Flickr export.
Guards six adaptive workflow measurements with a versioned measured baseline, exact semantic ratios and portable resource tolerances.
